intended_function: Support the separately defined computer workstation and provide the existing RoomDefinition-owned DESK_TOP surface.

citizen_scale.ratio_or_view: A 30-inch desk is 60 citizen-heights; use a 1:60 scale cue.

silhouette_requirements: Two perpendicular T-feet with low levelers.
Open knee space and visible paired supports at gameplay distance.

construction_materials.construction: One continuous flat panel with a finished thin edge
Two telescoping square columns attached below the glass by discrete plates and a slim support rail
Broad low-profile perpendicular rails with concealed leveling pads
Sparse fasteners below the tabletop only

art_direction: Human Room: restrained contemporary domestic-office furniture, realistic glass and coated metal, polished but not cinematic.
gameplay_distance_readability: Read as one large dark glass working surface on two distinct supports and T-feet; retain clear open space beneath the top.

prohibited_failure_modes: A fused fractured mesh, torn sheets, jagged gaps, floating or disconnected components.
A vertical tabletop or a single central leg replacing the two supports.
Unexplained raised discs, pucks, or fasteners on the glass surface.
Featureless near-black glass with no readable edge or material separation.
Invented furniture features that contradict the source or visible props merged into the desk.
Geometry outside or rescaled non-uniformly to fit the 66 x 30 x 30-inch envelope.
